office_does: The treasurer is the county's banker: the office collects and distributes property taxes for the county and local taxing districts, invests public funds and handles tax foreclosures.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Chris Nelson, first elected in 2018, is the only candidate and submitted no statement.

candidates.summary: Whitman County Treasurer since winning the 2018 election over the incumbent; previously the county's IT director. Unopposed in 2022 and again on this ballot; submitted no pamphlet statement.
highlights: Defeated incumbent Treasurer Mark Clinton in 2018, 51.75% to 48.25% in the reported count [S4]
County IT director from 2009, with 20 years in Washington county government before running [S3]
Unopposed in 2022, with 10,043 votes to 449 write-ins [S6]
